 K-drama 'Reply 1988' actor Ko Kyung-pyo caught drunk driving after truck crash
 By AGENCY 
 Sunday, 15 Nov 2026
 | 10:00 AM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Ko Kyung-pyo gained wider recognition for playing Sun-woo in tvN's popular series 'Reply 1988'. Ko Kyung-pyo/Instagram 
 K-drama actor Ko Kyung-pyo is under police investigation for drunk driving after crashing his car into a street-cleaning truck in Seoul early Saturday (Nov 14).
 The collision occurred at around 3.30am in Donggyo-dong, Mapo-gu, while Ko was driving his car, news reports said.
 Police officers dispatched to the scene administered a breathalyser test, which showed that Ko's blood alcohol concentration exceeded the legal threshold for license revocation.
 Under South Korean law, drivers with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.08% or higher face license revocation. Ko's exact blood alcohol level has not been disclosed.
 Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the crash, including why Ko got behind the wheel after drinking. It remains unclear whether anyone was injured.
 Ko's agency, CL&Company, issued an apology on his behalf, saying he had acknowledged his wrongdoing.
 "We sincerely apologise to those affected by Ko Kyung-pyo's drunk-driving accident. We also deeply regret the disappointment and concern caused to all those who have placed their trust in him and supported him," the agency said in a statement.
 Ko, 36, launched his acting career in 2010 with the KBS drama Jungle Fish 2  and gained wider recognition for playing Sun-woo in tvN's popular series Reply 1988 .
 He has since appeared in a number of television productions, including Don't Dare To Dream ,  Chicago Typewriter  and Love In Contract .
 The actor is scheduled to feature in the second season of tvN's variety show Bogum Magical , due to premiere in November, as well as Tving's The Great Escape: Urban Ghost Stories , slated for release in December. – The Korea Herald/Asia News Network
